# Depikt

> Depikt is an image creation workspace. Home is for creating; Library is for discovery; Account is for private creations and saved references.

## Product

- [Home / Create](https://www.depikt.app/): Describe an image and generate it with optional references. Improve prompt and Critique are optional tools in the same creator workspace.
- [Library](https://www.depikt.app/library): Three discovery tabs: Prompts, Templates, and Gallery. Search is scoped to the selected content type. Library includes historical GPT Image 2 examples and reviewed Images 2.5 recipes.
- [Templates](https://www.depikt.app/library?tab=templates): Reusable structures to start a creation.
- [Gallery](https://www.depikt.app/library?tab=gallery): Reference images to guide a creation.
- [Account](https://www.depikt.app/account): Sign-in required. Private creations, saved versions, downloads, and Reference Packs for characters, products, or brands. Account data is not public or available through MCP.
- [Pricing](https://www.depikt.app/pricing): Current plans and credit packs. Each successful generated image, edit, or regeneration costs one credit. A series costs one credit per successful image; failed image jobs return their reserved credit.
- [Help](https://www.depikt.app/help): Sign-in, references, credits, billing, and account help.

Generation routes internally; there is no model selector. When a request needs current, factual, or visual context, Depikt can research before generating (grounded generation). Results can be checked and, when needed, refined once automatically at no extra credit. Each successful generated image, edit, or regeneration still costs one credit; research, validation, and that included refinement do not.

Legacy /prompt, /generate, /critique, /gallery, and /templates links remain compatible entry points. Home and Library are the primary destinations.

## Guides and integrations

- [Blog / Field Notes](https://www.depikt.app/blog): Prompting, editing, references, product guides, and historical model guides.
- [MCP integration](https://www.depikt.app/integrations/mcp): Public, read-only prompts, templates, and published guides. Endpoint: https://www.depikt.app/mcp. No private accounts, writes, or image generation.
- [Sitemap](https://www.depikt.app/sitemap.xml): Public indexable routes.
